topologyEvidence.finding: The evaluated body is fully manifold with no open eyelid boundary. The visible aperture is backed by continuous socket geometry, so an open-loop eyelid construction cannot be inferred from boundary edges.

r997EyeDepth.finding: A 0.5 mm inward shift remains collision-free but produces no meaningful visual gain. At 1.0 mm the corneas produce 174 body triangle overlaps; at 1.5 mm the sclera and corneas produce 452 overlaps.

r998EyelidRelief.finding: All four strengths remain collision-free and preserve skin luminance at 0.665378809, but the strongest bound changes only 0.01963% of pixels and has mean absolute pixel delta 0.000000429. The selected vertices lie mostly on visually occluded socket surfaces, so the relief has no useful visible effect.

brightnessConclusion.finding: The current target-native branch is not progressively darkening. Dark hair framing, orbital shadow and the older website texture create the darker impression.
